field.label: Pick from catalog
field.help: Searchable list of the relays in the signed relays.md catalog (name, country, description). Picking one fills in the name and the operator below; both stay editable.

field.label: Relay
field.help: Relay name as in relays.md, for example anon-cs-de.

field.label: Operator
field.help: Who runs this relay. Pre-filled from the name (anon- stripped, first label, aliases such as cs → cryptostorm). A resolver can never use a relay with its own operator. This is an application-level separation, not proof against collusion.
